description: Run on an ICA compiler to restore its CA config to proxy mode: drops bootstrap.cfg's intermediate-ca-service entry and sets certificate-authority.proxy-target in ca.conf. Takes effect only after peadm::restart_ca_service restarts pe-puppetserver.

proxy_target.description: Where the compiler should forward CSRs once running as a proxy again: "primary", or a URL for an ICA pool member.
